# Jubilee Multi-Tool Motion Platform — Agent SKILL (`jubilee` v1.0.0)

## 1. Prerequisites & Operating Rules
- Select bundle: `--bundle jubilee` (or `--bundle <bundle_dir>` / `CLI_DEVICE_BUNDLE`).
- Start daemon first: `cli-device-d --bundle jubilee --socket /tmp/cli-device-d.sock`.
- Targets needing an installed `cli_any_device.adapters` plugin before use: `duet_real` (adapter `duet_rrf`), `mujoco_twin` (adapter `mujoco_twin`), `grbl_sim` (adapter `grbl_sim`).
- Built-in `--target in_memory` runs an offline in-memory fake (no physical actuation).
- Live changes on real hardware require a verified bundle and daemon startup with `--allow-live-hardware`.
- Always pass `--json` and an explicit `--target <target>`.
- Start every session with `sys detect` then `sys preflight`.
- Run `--dry-run` before mutating sequences; pass `--confirm` only when authorized.
- Use structured domain verbs instead of guessing raw coordinates or commands.
- On hardware/simulator targets (not `in_memory`), commands wait for supervisor completion: Every motion/state-mutating atomic service MUST append M400 (wait for moves to finish) and poll the RRF object model until state.status == "idle" and declared postconditions match (homed flags, active tool, lock sensor). NEVER treat HTTP 200 from /rr_gcode as motion completion.

## 2. Atomic Service Catalog
```text
sys.detect()                           -> endpoint, api_mode, firmware [R0]
sys.status()                           -> pos, homed, tool, safe_z   [R0]
sys.preflight()                        -> readiness_report           [R0]
sys.abort()                            -> ESTOP_LATCHED              [R0, lock-free]
sys.reset_estop()                      -> lifecycle=IDLE, homed=[]   [R3, --confirm]
deck.load_deck(spec)                   -> slots, safe_z              [R1, conditional --confirm]
deck.load_labware(slot, spec, top_z_mm?) -> well_map, top_z            [R1]
deck.safe_z(z_mm)                      -> safe_z                     [R1]
motion.home_all()                      -> homed=[X,Y,Z,U]            [R3, --confirm]
motion.home_xyu()                      -> homed+=[X,Y,U]             [R3, --confirm]
motion.home_z()                        -> homed+=[Z]                 [R3, --confirm]
motion.move_safe(x, y, z?, speed?)     -> pos=(x,y,z)                [R2]
motion.move_to(x, y, z, speed?)        -> pos=(x,y,z)                [R2]
motion.move_rel(dx?, dy?, dz?, speed?) -> pos=(x+dx,y+dy,z+dz)       [R2]
motion.move_well(slot, well, dz?)      -> pos=well(slot,well)+dz     [R2]
tool.pickup(tool_id)                   -> active_tool=tool_id        [R3, --confirm]
tool.park()                            -> active_tool=null           [R3, --confirm]
```

## 3. Standard Agent Loop
1. `cli-device --bundle jubilee --json --target <target> sys detect`
2. `cli-device --bundle jubilee --json --target <target> sys preflight`
3. `cli-device --bundle jubilee --json --target <target> --dry-run <group> <verb> [args...]`
4. Execute live (with `--confirm` when required) and inspect `.ok` and `.error.step`.

## 4. Fault & Emergency-Stop Protocol
- Exit codes: `0`=ok/dry-run, `1`=exec fault (fail-safe applied),
  `2`=usage/capability, `3`=safety denied (zero actuation),
  `4`=needs `--confirm`, `5`=timeout, `99`=e-stop latched.
- On non-zero exit, do NOT blindly retry R3 commands: run `sys status` first.
- Software halt: `cli-device --bundle jubilee --json --target <target> sys abort` (lock-free).
- E-stop policy: Software `cli-device sys abort` sends M112 over a lock-free, out-of-band HTTP channel that does not wait on ActionDriver mutexes. CRITICAL: M112 does NOT cut 12/24 V motor/heater power. A dedicated, human-tested physical emergency stop / power-cut relay within operator reach is MANDATORY before any real-machine motion. After e-stop, the daemon latches HALTED until human inspection, explicit confirmed reset (M999), and full re-homing.
